name: live-assistant
description: A real-time voice assistant for React Native apps and the web, built on Gemini Live.
author: Recep Tayyip Ekşi

scripts.build: npm run build -w @live-assistant/core && npm run build -w @live-assistant/gemini && npm run build -w @live-assistant/audio && npm run build -w @live-assistant/react && npm run build -w @live-assistant/token-server && npm run build -w @live-assistant/widget && npm run build -w @live-assistant/react-native
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run check:pack && npm run check:docs
